name: Pagination
description: Page navigation with smart ellipsis truncation (boundary and sibling counts), Previous/Next buttons and an active-page indicator that springs from page to page. Works controlled or uncontrolled.
a11yNotes: Rendered as <nav aria-label> with a list of native buttons, so it is fully operable with Tab, Enter and Space. Each page button is labelled 'Page N' and the current page carries aria-current="page"; Previous/Next have explicit labels and are disabled at the ends. Ellipses are aria-hidden. A visually hidden polite live region announces 'Page X of Y' after each change. Under prefers-reduced-motion the indicator moves instantly.
